name: circleit
description: Draw on any web page in Chrome and send design feedback straight into this Codex thread.

interface.shortDescription: Design feedback drawn on your web pages, straight into Codex
interface.longDescription: Circle, box or pin anything on a web page in Chrome, type what you want changed, and press Send. CircleIt delivers the annotated screenshots and the exact DOM elements (selectors, text, styles, source-file hints) to this Codex thread, which picks the feedback up, makes the change, and reports back to the person who sent it.
defaultPrompt: Wait for CircleIt feedback and handle it
